name.text: Finding the number of axes of rotational symmetry a given solid has

questiontext.text:
How many axes of rotational symmetry does the solid have?

[[jsxgraph]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid,{ boundingbox:[-7,6,8,-6], axis:false, showCopyright:false }); var solid={#solid_id#}; /* ======================= CUBE ======================= */ if(solid==1){ var A=board.create('point',[-2,2],{visible:false}); var B=board.create('point',[2,2],{visible:false}); var C=board.create('point',[2,-2],{visible:false}); var D=board.create('point',[-2,-2],{visible:false}); var dx=1.5,dy=1.3; var E=board.create('point',[-2+dx,2+dy],{visible:false}); var F=board.create('point',[2+dx,2+dy],{visible:false}); var G=board.create('point',[2+dx,-2+dy],{visible:false}); var H=board.create('point',[-2+dx,-2+dy],{visible:false}); board.create('polygon',[A,B,C,D]); board.create('polygon',[E,F,G,H]); board.create('segment',[A,E]); board.create('segment',[B,F]); board.create('segment',[C,G]); board.create('segment',[D,H]); } /* ======================= CUBOID ======================= */ else if(solid==2){ var A=board.create('point',[-3,1.5],{visible:false}); var B=board.create('point',[3,1.5],{visible:false}); var C=board.create('point',[3,-1.5],{visible:false}); var D=board.create('point',[-3,-1.5],{visible:false}); var dx=2,dy=1.2; var E=board.create('point',[-3+dx,1.5+dy],{visible:false}); var F=board.create('point',[3+dx,1.5+dy],{visible:false}); var G=board.create('point',[3+dx,-1.5+dy],{visible:false}); var H=board.create('point',[-3+dx,-1.5+dy],{visible:false}); board.create('polygon',[A,B,C,D]); board.create('polygon',[E,F,G,H]); board.create('segment',[A,E]); board.create('segment',[B,F]); board.create('segment',[C,G]); board.create('segment',[D,H]); } /* ======================= CONE ======================= */ else if(solid==3){ // Apex var A = board.create('point',[0,3],{visible:false}); // Approximate circular base var pts = []; for(var i=0;i<24;i++){ var t = 2*Math.PI*i/24; pts.push(board.create('point',[ 2*Math.cos(t), -2 + 0.45*Math.sin(t) ],{visible:false})); } board.create('polygon',pts,{ fillColor:'#dbeafe', fillOpacity:0.5, borders:{strokeWidth:2} }); // Join apex to left and right extremes board.create('segment',[A,pts[12]],{strokeWidth:2}); board.create('segment',[A,pts[0]],{strokeWidth:2}); } /* ======================= CYLINDER ======================= */ else if(solid==4){ var top=[]; var bottom=[]; for(var i=0;i<24;i++){ var t=2*Math.PI*i/24; top.push( board.create('point',[ 2*Math.cos(t), 2+0.45*Math.sin(t) ],{visible:false}) ); bottom.push( board.create('point',[ 2*Math.cos(t), -2+0.45*Math.sin(t) ],{visible:false}) ); } board.create('polygon',top,{ fillColor:'#dbeafe', fillOpacity:0.3, borders:{strokeWidth:2} }); board.create('polygon',bottom,{ fillColor:'#dbeafe', fillOpacity:0.3, borders:{strokeWidth:2} }); // Vertical edges board.create('segment',[top[0],bottom[0]],{strokeWidth:2}); board.create('segment',[top[12],bottom[12]],{strokeWidth:2}); } /* ======================= TETRAHEDRON ======================= */ else if(solid==5){ var A=board.create('point',[0,3],{visible:false}); var B=board.create('point',[-3,-2],{visible:false}); var C=board.create('point',[3,-2],{visible:false}); var D=board.create('point',[0,0],{visible:false}); board.create('polygon',[A,B,C]); board.create('segment',[A,D]); board.create('segment',[B,D]); board.create('segment',[C,D]); } /* ======================= TRIANGULAR PRISM ======================= */ else{ var A=board.create('point',[-3,2],{visible:false}); var B=board.create('point',[-4,-2],{visible:false}); var C=board.create('point',[-1,-2],{visible:false}); var D=board.create('point',[2,3],{visible:false}); var E=board.create('point',[1,-1],{visible:false}); var F=board.create('point',[4,-1],{visible:false}); board.create('polygon',[A,B,C]); board.create('polygon',[D,E,F]); board.create('segment',[A,D]); board.create('segment',[B,E]); board.create('segment',[C,F]); } [[/jsxgraph]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

The solid shown is a {@solid_name@}.

It has {@num_axes@} axis (or axes) of rotational symmetry.

An axis of rotational symmetry is a line about which a solid can be rotated so that it appears unchanged.

Therefore, the correct answer is \[ \boxed{{@num_axes@}} \]
